en.headline: Lee to deliver five-year plan and Policy Address on Wednesday
en.dek: The chief executive said he and his team will wear THEi-designed ties, scarves and a blue ‘one-five’ badge when the documents are published on 16 September.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Sunday that he will publish Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and deliver his fifth Policy Address on Wednesday, 16 September, and previewed the accessories he and his team will wear that day.

In a social media post, Lee said the blue badge, designed by staff and students of the Technological and Higher Education Institute of Hong Kong, carries the characters for ‘one-five’ to stand for the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region’s first five-year plan. He said the motif of two overlapping squares is meant to represent gathering resources and talent from all sides.

The green tie and scarf, also designed at THEi, take their cue from technology development in the Northern Metropolis, Lee said. He added that last year’s Policy Address likewise used THEi-designed ties and scarves, and that this year the badge is new. He said he appreciated the students’ and teachers’ work and wanted to carry their expectations into the documents.

Lee has previously said the two papers would be issued together so the public can see how the annual Policy Address sits against the longer five-year framework. The government has not yet released the texts.

zh.headline: 李家超周三發表五年規劃及施政報告 團隊戴「一五」襟章
zh.dek: 行政長官周日在社交平台表示，9月16日將同時公布香港首個五年規劃及任內第五份《施政報告》，並預告當日佩戴高科院校友設計的領呔、絲巾及藍色襟章。
body: 行政長官李家超周日表示，將於9月16日（星期三）公布《香港第一個五年規劃》，並發表任內第五份《施政報告》。他在社交平台預告，當日他與團隊會佩戴由香港高等教育科技學院師生設計的領呔、絲巾及襟章。
李家超說，藍色襟章寫有「一五」，代表香港首個五年規劃；圖案以雙正方相疊為意念，寓意匯聚四面八方的資源及多元人才。領呔和絲巾為綠色，設計靈感來自北部都會區的科技發展。
他指出，去年宣讀《施政報告》時，團隊已佩戴高科院師生設計的領呔和絲巾，今年則加上襟章。他說十分欣賞師生的創意，期待帶着他們對五年規劃的期望，為未來五年作準備。
李家超較早前曾表示，兩份文件同日公布，是為方便公眾理解五年規劃與《施政報告》相輔相成的關係。文件內容尚未公開。
